name: Self-order portable tablet assignment screen
describe: PortableTabletAssignment: staff provisioning, not a customer screen. A portable/shared URY Ordering Device has no table until staff enter the 4-6 digit PIN on the keypad (64px keys, rounded-xl border-2) and then a table name or code; the PIN is only verified server-side at assignment.

Shown once, before the tablet is handed to a customer; after a successful assignment the tablet menu takes over. Base capture is the PIN step with four digits. RTL is a kit extension (the source has no dir handling): the kit mirrors with logical properties and translates the fixed UI labels.
